lander.name: Nova-C class (IoT estimate)
lander.model: sun-tracking array: power = p_panel x visible Sun fraction, whatever the Sun's direction, so survival is an upper bound for fixed panels

sources.p_load: ESTIMATE from Odysseus lasting 10-20 hours on battery (Reuters)

definitions.safe_landing_date: touchdown with more than half the Sun and Earth in view, Earth in view for at least 50% of the 14-day mission (no relay), and the battery never below 140 Wh
definitions.ranking: one list per mast height: most safe landing days (safe at every point within 100 m where that was checked; sites with none there are left out), then the least battery needed to bridge the longest darkness
definitions.bridge_Wh: battery energy needed to survive the longest darkness of the best landing date, at the lander's 50 W load
definitions.default_mast: 2 m: the best-fit observer height when the engine is checked against NASA's maps
definitions.recommended_mast_m: the shortest mast with at least one safe landing date (information only)
definitions.fields: per-mast numbers are for that mast's best landing date (best_dates[0]); null if it has none
